review_kind: pinned complete-package nested Qdrant static source-vetting; NOT governed semantic verification
rubric: 10 dimensions each scored 0-2; hard fail overrides numeric score
source_freshness: Pinned source snapshot dated 2026-11-01; Qdrant API-version assertions and external documentation not independently revalidated
macro_findings: All 15 nested Qdrant SKILL.md files have distinct blobs and first-class frontmatter; one scaling-data-volume parent contains four nested SKILL.md descendants, so package-level and path-level identities overlap without being duplicate blobs.
Four direct-shape Qdrant parent router SKILL.md files were read for dependency context but are not terminally reviewed or counted in this tranche.

13 procedures fail unchanged-use on missing production mutation, cloud-spend, sensitive telemetry, data retention or package/egress authorization; two remain reference-only for decision routing or conceptual approximation.
The sliding-time-window procedure directly instructs shard/collection/point deletion without retention-owner authorization or legal-hold/recovery checks.

Vector database operations and retrieval relevance lack a narrow dedicated domain in the current 32-domain directory; map conservatively to existing backend, SRE, measurement, security and cost-optimization subdomains until the governed taxonomy owner resolves it.
All Qdrant claims are version/workload sensitive; no security scan, representative run or performance/quality benchmark was executed.
